name: Panasonic KX-TG6822 DECT Twin with Answer
short_description: In stock in store at 29 Church St, Dundalk. Photo to be confirmed.
description: The Panasonic KX-TG6822 is a premium DECT cordless phone (twin handset set) with a dedicated Call Blocker to stop nuisance numbers, Noise Reduction for clearer calls and a bright 1.8-inch backlit display. A built-in answering machine records up to 30 minutes of messages. Power-failure talk keeps you connected in a blackout, and it supports up to six handsets.
features: Dedicated Call Blocker for nuisance calls
